steps.check: list route reports the folder and only image files
steps.expr: (async () => { const response = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/list'); if (!response.ok) return false; const payload = await response.json(); const names = payload.images.map((entry) => entry.name); return typeof payload.folder === 'string' && payload.folder.includes('backgrounds') && payload.folder.startsWith('~') && names.includes('sample-background.png') && names.includes('probe.svg') && !names.includes('notes.txt') && payload.images.every((entry) => entry.bytes > 0 && typeof entry.rev === 'string') && payload.accepted.includes('.png'); })()

steps.check: HEAD list answers without a body
steps.expr: (async () => { const response = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/list', { method: 'HEAD' }); if (!response.ok) return false; const text = await response.text(); return text === ''; })()

steps.check: image route serves the file with an entity tag and revalidates
steps.expr: (async () => { const first = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/files/sample-background.png'); if (!first.ok) return false; if (first.headers.get('content-type') !== 'image/png') return false; const etag = first.headers.get('etag'); if (etag === null) return false; const second = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/files/sample-background.png', { headers: { 'if-none-match': etag } }); return second.status === 304; })()

steps.check: image route rejects traversal and unknown files
steps.expr: (async () => { const encoded = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/files/..%2Fnotes.txt'); const plain = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/files/notes.txt'); const unknown = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/nope'); return encoded.status === 404 && plain.status === 404 && unknown.status === 404; })()

steps.check: folder route requires POST and the plugin header
steps.expr: (async () => { const get = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/folder'); const post = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/folder', { method: 'POST' }); return get.status === 405 && post.status === 403; })()

(async () => { const response = await fetch('/chat-backgrounds/token-total'); if (!response.ok) return false; const payload = await response.json(); const sum = payload.uncachedInputTokens + payload.outputTokens + payload.cacheReadTokens + payload.cacheWriteTokens; return payload.total === sum && Number.isInteger(payload.sessions) && Number.isInteger(payload.countedSessions) && payload.countedSessions <= payload.sessions; })()
